notes.title: Reset leaderboard and update score system
notes.notes:
- Leaderboards has been reset
- US leaderboard is now working
- The points for a bot kill is now divided by 10 to advantage games in the leaderboard against real player

notes.title: Patch Notes - 3/22/2023 - Ver.10831314
notes.notes:
- Change recoil AK-47 and AR-15
- Add weapon damage info (body, headshot) in inventory
- Now when you switch weapon and hold aim you will aim

notes.title: Patch Notes - 3/21/2023 - Ver.10822868
notes.notes:
- Improve crosshair with low scale
- Fix bug with sniper when you aim you was able to block zoomed
- Extract point is now directly on ground
- Reduce recoil of AK and AR when you don't aim, add bloom when you full or don't aim

notes.title: Patch Notes - 3/20/2023 - Ver.10813385
notes.notes:
- Removed the ability to switch weapon when you aim
- Improved fall damage process (no more ghost hit by fall damage)
- Bots are a little bit stronger
- New leaderboard and stats for the week 2 of Pre-Season 1
- Added bloom after the first bullet shot while you jump, this is reset when you hit the ground.
- When you move your skin in your inventory the menu now disapear
- Add menu with the binds of skin menu
- SR-62 skin are not better centered in skin inventory
- Increase Voice in game range
- Fixed the bug when you were not able to move your camera at the begining of the game
- New map optimization, you should have more FPS
- Removed a lot of cars on the map
- Increased drop rate of items because we have less spawner locations by removing the cars
- You can now grab items 2 times faster on ground
- You should not be able to cross kill with weapon
- Decapitator nerfed
- Fix bug where you were able to force the third slot without a military backpack
- When you are hiding behind a wall you should not be able to shoot someone who don't see you
- Fixed when you break your military bullet vest you can now craft a normal one

notes.title: Patch Notes - 3/16/2023 - Ver.10788148
notes.notes:
[h2]Character/Inventory:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now in inventory when you move your character with the tab menu open, items will no longer reorder. Items you remove will be removed and an empty slot will exist for you.
[*] Removed text on the character/back of your weapon.
[*] Mouse cursor will now appear when you open the map.
[*] When another player does not see you, you can't shoot him through any obstacles.
[*] Increase helmet resistance to increase the skill gap of a 2 tap
[*] Now you can shred medium backpack for 1 plate armor
[/list]

[h2]Weapons/Grenade Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reduced damage distance and grenade damage.
[*] Reduced the number of grenades.
[/list]
[list]
[*] You may carry:
[*] 2 with basic backpack,
[*] 3 with medium and 
[*] 5 with military
[/list]
[list]
[*] You can now drop your bullet vest so you can craft a new one. If you had a military before you were not able to craft a new one.
[*] Bullet drop has been increased.
[*] Reduced the speed of player with weapon.
[/list]
You can now “Put away” your weapon and run. This speed is what you used to run with your weapon out.  (New input added in order to remove your actual weapon from your hand)


[h3]Weapons sounds have been updated.[/h3]

[h2]Sounds :[/h2]

[list]
[*] Better spatialization
[*] New weapon sounds based on the distance
[/list]
 Sounds can now be heard up to 300 meters away.
• Glock ~> 150m
• Ak & M4 ~> 250m
• Decapitator ~> 250m
• SVD ~> 300m

[h2] Level Design & Map :[/h2]

[list]
[*] Foliage has been reduced
[*] Loot fixed in the buildings
[*] Mall roof patched (you can now reach the roof without having weird circles on the floor)
[*] Collision around buildings fixed 
[*] Reduction of small objects that was blocking the players from freely moving.
[*] AI spawner fixed
[*] Door collisions fixed
[*] Mesh of the hosital fixed 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3/14/2023 ver.10768042
notes.notes:
[h2]Fix and Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Matchmaking stability improvements. 
[*] Repetitive zombie sound in hospital has been fixed.
[*] When shredding items our available inventory will fill. But if inventory is filled loot will fall to the ground.
[*] Skin bug removing weapon rarity has been fixed.
[*] The bullet proof vest bug after aiming down the scope of the sniper has been repaired and fixed.
[*] "AK Marble Fragment" issue fixed.
[*] New hit markers sound
[/list]

[h2]New weight and backpack capacity[/h2]

[h3]New backpack capacity:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Basic backpack: [b]100[/b] => [b]150[/b]
[*] Medium backpack: [b]200[/b]=> [b]300[/b]
[*] Military backpack: [b]400[/b] => [b]600[/b]
[/list]

[h3]New bullet weight:[/h3]

[list]
[*] AK, AR, P19: [b]1[/b] => [b]0.25[/b]
[*] Decapitator: [b]4[/b] => [b]1[/b]
[/list]
